comments.author: Kosevo
comments.body:
Does this panel give the same performance of Iron Paneling or Nation Iron Paneling? Someone confirm me this piece of info Danke!

Iron Paneling : dura=140% , speed 95%
Nation Iron Panel : dura=141% , speed 96%

Or is this panel exactly like "Festive Metal Paneling" (which has 140%/95% stats)?

comments.author: Benjy~
comments.body:
[Ceremonial/Festive/Celebratory/Nocturnal/Noble] METAL Paneling give the same performance of IRON Paneling. (Iron Paneling : dura=140% , speed 95%)

[Ceremonial/Festive/Celebratory/Nocturnal/Noble] WOOD Paneling give the same perfomance of TEAK Paneling. (Teak Paneling : dura=105% , Speed 105%)

comments.author: Kosevo
comments.body: Thanks. Finally the answer I wanted to hear!
